lines.en: I come up out of the sand and walk.

lines.zh: 沙地上我走得比看起来快
lines.en: I'm faster on sand than I look.

lines.zh: 我有好几条腿，走起来沙沙响
lines.en: Many legs, and they rasp on sand.
Grit is stuck to my shell.

lines.zh: 我从一个沙丘走到另一个
lines.en: I go from one dune to the next.
I keep low against the sand.
My claws gouge deep lines.
I can read this sand field.
I avoid the hard ground.
Sand slides off my back.

lines.zh: 走一段，我就沉下去一点
lines.en: Every so often I sink a little.

lines.zh: 沙面一震，我就往那边挪
lines.en: When the surface trembles, I move that way
I'm half buried in sand.
Only my eyes and two claws show.

lines.zh: 我在等东西从上面走过
lines.en: I'm waiting for something to walk over me.
The sand moves, and it isn't me.
My shell is thick.
I don't need to stand tall.
My claws rest on the sand.

lines.zh: 风一层层往我壳上盖沙
lines.en: The wind layers sand over my shell
I've lain in this sand for years.
I'm listening to the sound in the sand.
You're standing on my sand.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，我们都在沙里
lines.en: You can't see me; we're both in the sand.
My claw is thicker than your arm.
You came too close.
I wait in this sand.
My shell doesn't fear your blade.
I can read your footprints.
One more step and you're on me.
I come out slowly; don't move.
This sand field is mine.
A corner of my carapace broke.
I sink back into the sand.
It landed off-center and it still hurt.
I raise a claw to block.
Sand falls off me.

lines.zh: 血混进沙里，看不出多少
lines.en: Blood mixes into the sand, and you can't tell how much

lines.zh: 左边第二条腿断了半截
lines.en: The second leg on my left snapped halfway

lines.zh: 疼也不喊，沙地里喊很蠢
lines.en: I don't yell; yelling in sand is foolish.
I'll scratch that into my shell.
The sand will hide me.

lines.zh: 活物才会让我把钳张开
lines.en: Only living prey makes me open my pincers

lines.zh: 你放下的东西会沉下去
lines.en: What you put down will sink.

lines.zh: 沙里的东西才对我胃口
lines.en: Only what's in the sand suits me.
You hold it up; I can't reach.
I don't know this smell.
Reach any closer and I'll snip it off
My claws can't crack this.

lines.zh: 这东西留在你手里就好
lines.en: Better that thing stays in your hands
I can't be bothered to lift a pincer
I don't touch any of these.
You stepped on me; here's a claw.
I push up out of the sand.
My shell is hard; it hurts to hit.
That one pushed you back.
I bury myself and you come again.
The sand hides me.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，沙飞起来
lines.en: We collided and the sand flew.
Don't jump on the sand.
I shift slowly aside.
You already stepped once.
I'm not the only one under the sand.

lines.zh: 我们在沙里互相找不到
lines.en: We can't find each other in the sand.
That, when we molt.

lines.zh: 我的钳用来挖，不用来牵
lines.en: My claws dig, they don't hold.
This sand field is big enough.
No one speaks of such things under the sand
That burrow below was dug by someone else.

lines.zh: 沙底下的动静，谁也听不见
lines.en: Nothing under the sand can be heard
Don't stand here waiting.
Sand covers everything.
I pinch it with a claw.

lines.zh: 沙里的东西我都翻一遍
lines.en: I sift through what's in the sand.
This is too soft.
I pinched it and it broke.
That on the ground isn't worth it.
I drag it along.
The sand buried it.
This isn't mine.
I dug this up.
Put it down.
Something's moving on the sand.
I hear footsteps.
That shadow isn't big.
I'm half-buried.
I'll wait for it to come.
It's within my reach.
I come up from below.
The sand shifts beneath me.
It stepped on my sand.
The sand quivered; now.
I open my claws.

lines.zh: 我伏在沙下，等它把脚踩实
lines.en: I lie under the sand and wait for it to plant a foot
At this distance one claw reaches.
I've fixed on it.
I surface at its flank.
I've been ready a long while.
A fresh print on the sand.
It's beyond the dune.
I track it under the sand.
Its feet sink in the sand.
It's slower than me.

lines.zh: 我往它的落点又埋深半尺
lines.en: I sink half a foot deeper toward where it will step
The sand bulges.
It stopped to look.
I stop under its feet.
It planted its foot.
This is the moment.

lines.zh: 每走一步，沙就往我这边滑
lines.en: With every step the sand slides toward me
It took half a step back.
I bury myself again.
It's looking for me.
Its shadow tells me where it is.
One more breath.
The sand is hissing.
It's starting to panic.
Its foot is planted; now.

lines.zh: 我埋在它脚下，等它站稳
lines.en: I lie under its feet, waiting for it to settle.

lines.zh: 它每走一步，我就跟一步
lines.en: Every step it takes, I take one.
My claws clamp down.
Both claws clamp down.
It caught a leg.
I burst fully out of the sand.
I pried its armor open.
I slam down and sand sprays.
That buried me in my own sand.
It backed off; I burrow after it.
Sand in my claws, poor grip.

lines.zh: 我这一钳下去，它跪了半截
lines.en: One pincer strike and it drops to half a knee
I pinch again.
That will slow it.
On sand I'm never at a disadvantage.
It jumped clear.
I press it down into the sand.
Once my claw takes hold, it doesn't let go.
I lift its feet from below.
That one brought sand, and it grates.
It can't hold its footing in sand.
I butt it with my shell.
The sand bulges first.
I crawl up from below the sand.
Wet sand clings to my shell.
This sand is enough to hide me.
I raise my claws.
Sand pours off my back.
I land here without a sound.
No other living thing on this dune.
I test the sand with a claw.
Half of me is still under.
Footsteps; I hide first.
I sink back slowly.
Fire baked my shell red.

lines.zh: 我从沙里摔下去，翻了个身
lines.en: I fell and rolled over.
Flooded, I float up.
The blast blew the sand away.
The arrow bounced off my shell.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我整只缩起来
lines.en: The spell hit and I curled up.
Hungry, my shell thins.

lines.zh: 雷打进沙里，我全身一麻
lines.en: Lightning struck the sand and numbed me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙，我抓不住
lines.en: No sand in the void; nothing to grip.
